data.narrative:
Stratolaunch is a private-stage space and aerospace company operating in a sector with 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Neither of the two standard triangulation methods could be applied to derive a valuation range. Peer-median analysis failed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparables within the space and aerospace sector—while 14 same-sector peers exist broadly, none met the filtering criteria for narrow peer set construction (minimum three datapoints). Public-comp anchoring could not proceed because Stratolaunch's revenue is not on file; the broader Space & Aerospace public universe trades at a median P/S of 24.4x across the six public tickers, but without disclosed revenue this multiple cannot be operationalized against the target.

This analysis cannot produce a defensible valuation range given current data availability. A path forward would require either: (i) Stratolaunch's disclosed or estimated annual revenue to enable public-comp anchoring; or (ii) transaction multiples or valuations from recent private fundings of similarly-staged peers to construct a narrow peer median. Until one of these inputs is available, quantitative triangulation remains inapplicable, and any estimate would rest on transaction precedent or management guidance rather than systematic comparable analysis.
